PENDING.label: Pending
PENDING.detail: The connection was started but not authorized yet. Finish the process with the provider.

CONNECTING.label: Connecting
CONNECTING.detail: Waiting for the provider's confirmation. It can take a few seconds.

DEGRADED.label: With issues
DEGRADED.detail: Messages keep arriving, but something is off. Worth checking before it stops.

ERROR.label: Error
ERROR.detail: Syncing is stopped. The error must be resolved to send and receive again.

REVOKED.label: Permission withdrawn
REVOKED.detail: The provider withdrew the authorization. The channel must be connected again.

DISCONNECTED.label: Disconnected
DISCONNECTED.detail: This channel no longer syncs. You can connect it again whenever you want.

onboarding.notFound: This channel has no guided connection flow.
onboarding.pathsDescription: Choose how you want to connect. You can only follow one of the three options, and it cannot be changed later without disconnecting.

COEXISTENCE.title: Connect my current WhatsApp Business number
COEXISTENCE.description: You keep using your number in the WhatsApp Business app on your phone, and Kindly syncs those conversations behind the scenes.

NEW_ACCOUNT.title: Create a new WhatsApp Business account
NEW_ACCOUNT.description: A new number, dedicated to Kindly, unrelated to the one you use on your phone today.
NEW_ACCOUNT.unavailable: Not available yet. Kindly has only adopted the coexistence option for now; this one needs a product decision that has not been made.

MIGRATE_BSP.title: Migrate from another provider (BSP)
MIGRATE_BSP.description: Bring to Kindly a number that already runs with another WhatsApp API provider.
MIGRATE_BSP.unavailable: Not available yet. Migrating between providers has its own Meta rules that must be verified before offering it.

onboarding.preflightDescription: These are not Kindly's terms: each point is a Meta requirement or a real consequence for the phone you carry. Confirm all of them to continue.

business-app.title: The number is on the WhatsApp Business app
business-app.detail: It must be WhatsApp Business (version 2.24.17 or later), not the regular WhatsApp app. If you use the consumer app, this option is not possible with that number.

not-on-cloud-api.title: The number is not already registered on the Cloud API
not-on-cloud-api.detail: A number that was already registered on the WhatsApp API on its own cannot join through coexistence.

business-manager.title: The number is added to the organization's Business Manager
business-manager.detail: Meta requires the number to belong to the Business Manager from which the connection is authorized.

history.title: Up to 180 days of history will sync
history.detail: Individual conversations only, never groups. Attachments only arrive for messages from the last 14 days.

disabled-features.title: You will lose some features on your phone
disabled-features.detail: Disappearing messages, view once, live location and broadcast lists are turned off. WhatsApp for Windows and WearOS are unlinked during the process.

cost.title: Messages sent from Kindly are billed
cost.detail: What you send from your phone stays free. What is sent from Kindly goes through the Cloud API at Meta's standard cost.

onboarding.countryHint: Two-letter code. We check that coexistence is available in that country before starting.
onboarding.countryUnknown: We cannot yet check automatically whether coexistence is available in your country: Meta does not publish the list of excluded regions in a format we can query, and copying it from an unofficial source would be worse than not checking. Confirm with Meta if in doubt.
onboarding.whatNextBody: Kindly will ask the provider to connect with your account. Follow the provider's instructions if it asks for any and come back: the channel's status shows on this screen.
